name: Composite Cross Domain Variant 8
task:
Please complete the following four-stage multi-domain task.

A manufacturing plant report (20 pages): 3 production lines, capacity 100K units/year each. Upgrade proposals: Line A ($2M, 20% efficiency), Line B ($1.5M, 15% efficiency), Line C ($3M, 30% efficiency). Budget: $5M.

Calculate NPV of the investment.

Optimize budget allocation.

Recommend the best course of action.
